text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This paper presents a national-scale spatial implementation covering the entire main island of Taiwan (~35,808 sq.km). The primary focus is on LULC prediction and simulation from 1990 to 2050, using multiple future scenarios (four different variable combinations) with quantitative comparisons. The methodology integrates Support Vector Machine classification with Markov Chain modeling, providing spatially explicit mapped LULC projections for 2030 and 2050. Accuracy assessments with quantitative metrics (overall accuracy, kappa) are reported for both classified historical data and simulated future maps.
